name: Problem Framing Canvas
deliverable: Bounded problem definition with user impact and business context

steps.text: Bound the work: problem, not features or specs.
Each person notes one observable friction silently.
Map frictions to revenue, churn, or support load.
Cluster duplicates, then draft three problem statements and choose the one the room defends.

failure: Solution jumping: the statement names the fix the room already wanted, so the session debates a tool.
intervention: Strip the tool out. Ask what in the workflow costs measurable time or money, then rewrite without a product.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in design practice; no single documented originator.
